name: en-dark-1440
text:
Critical-minerals supply

Annual physical-supply context, not a live shortage indicator or a position recommendation.

USGS edition 2026 · Published 2026-02-06

Cobalt

Congo (Kinshasa) mined about 74% of the world's cobalt in 2025, and the US imported about 79 percent of what it used.

Observation period: 2025

Lithium

Australia mined about 32% of the world's lithium in 2025, and the US imported more than 50 percent of what it used.

Observation period: 2025

Gallium

China produced about 100% of the world's gallium in 2025, and the US imported about 100 percent of what it used.

Observation period: 2025

Rare earths

China mined about 69% of the world's rare earths in 2025, and the US imported about 67 percent of what it used.

Observation period: 2025

Source and timing

USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries data release
